nodes.directText: You can control the order of service startup and shutdown with the attribute. Compose always starts and stops containers in dependency order, where dependencies are determined by , , , and .
nodes.subtreeText: You can control the order of service startup and shutdown with the depends_on attribute. Compose always starts and stops containers in dependency order, where dependencies are determined by depends_on , links , volumes_from , and network_mode: "service:..." .

nodes.directText: For example, if your application needs to access a database and both services are started with , there is a chance this will fail since the application service might start before the database service and won't find a database able to handle
nodes.subtreeText: For example, if your application needs to access a database and both services are started with docker compose up , there is a chance this will fail since the application service might start before the database service and won't find a database able to handle its SQL statements.

nodes.directText: On startup, Compose does not wait until a container is "ready", only until it's running. This can cause issues if, for example, you have a relational database system that needs to start its own services before being able to handle incoming
nodes.subtreeText: On startup, Compose does not wait until a container is "ready", only until it's running. This can cause issues if, for example, you have a relational database system that needs to start its own services before being able to handle incoming connections.

nodes.directText: The solution for detecting the ready state of a service is to use the attribute with one of the following options:
nodes.subtreeText: The solution for detecting the ready state of a service is to use the condition attribute with one of the following options:

service_started service_healthy . This specifies that a dependency is expected to be “healthy”, which is defined with healthcheck , before starting a dependent service. service_completed_successfully . This specifies that a dependency is expected to run to successful completion before starting a dependent service.

nodes.directText: . This specifies that a dependency is expected to be “healthy”, which is defined with , before starting a dependent service.
nodes.subtreeText: service_healthy . This specifies that a dependency is expected to be “healthy”, which is defined with healthcheck , before starting a dependent service.

nodes.directText: . This specifies that a dependency is expected to run to successful completion before starting a dependent service.
nodes.subtreeText: service_completed_successfully . This specifies that a dependency is expected to run to successful completion before starting a dependent service.

nodes.directText: Compose creates services in dependency order. and are created before .
nodes.subtreeText: Compose creates services in dependency order. db and redis are created before web .

nodes.directText: Compose waits for healthchecks to pass on dependencies marked with . is expected to be "healthy" (as indicated by ) before is created.
nodes.subtreeText: Compose waits for healthchecks to pass on dependencies marked with service_healthy . db is expected to be "healthy" (as indicated by healthcheck ) before web is created.

nodes.directText: ensures that if is updated or restarted due to an explicit Compose operation, for example , the service is also restarted automatically, ensuring it re-establishes connections or dependencies correctly.
nodes.subtreeText: restart: true ensures that if db is updated or restarted due to an explicit Compose operation, for example docker compose restart , the web service is also restarted automatically, ensuring it re-establishes connections or dependencies correctly.

nodes.directText: The healthcheck for the service uses the command to check if the PostgreSQL database is ready. The service is retried every 10 seconds, up to 5 times.
nodes.subtreeText: The healthcheck for the db service uses the pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER} -d ${POSTGRES_DB} command to check if the PostgreSQL database is ready. The service is retried every 10 seconds, up to 5 times.

nodes.directText: Compose also removes services in dependency order. is removed before and .
nodes.subtreeText: Compose also removes services in dependency order. web is removed before db and redis .
